reasons: Conflicting constraints: CS3223 and CS4248 must be in the same semester (Sem 8), but ES2660 and CS4248 must also be in the same semester, forcing ES2660 into Sem 8. However, ES2660 and CS3223 must be in the same semester, which is consistent. The conflict arises because CS4248 requires CS2109S (completed) and math prerequisites (MA1521 completed, MA1522 completed, but MA2116/ST2131/MA2216/ST2334/YSC2243 is needed for the second part of the prerequisite. The student has ST2334 completed. So CS4248 is eligible. The main conflict is the 'At most 2 modules per semester' rule combined with the requirement that ES2660, CS3223, and CS4248 are all in the same semester (Sem 8). This would require 3 modules in Sem 8, violating the limit.
